pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: app/api/brand/route.ts:87 PUT /api/brand overwrites an org-wide setting that re-skins every workspace and candidate-facing page, and the write records no old value, new value, origin or actor, only the row's updated_at. So 'who changed the brand, and from what' has no answer, and nothing can revert it.

techniques.evidence: app/api/brand/route.ts:87 saveBrand (app/_lib/brand-store.ts) upserts in place with only updated_at. A grep found no audit call for brand writes anywhere under app/_lib.

app/_lib/templates-store.ts:56 The store behind /api/templates seeds the shipped 'Company standard' template into a user-editable collection behind a COUNT(*) gate instead of a ledger of applied defaults. A newly shipped default would never reach an install whose org tier already holds rows. The repo's own seed_marks rule forbids this gate too.

app/api/compliance/route.ts:55 The stored regime is normalized at the read boundary, so a stale or hand-edited row falls back to the declared EU default instead of an empty jurisdiction. The brand read also re-runs sanitizeBrand on every read.
app/api/brand/route.ts:79 An invalid accent is refused with a reason code. Before, the write answered 200 and silently replaced the color with null, so the editor could not tell the save had failed.

pairs.evidence: app/features/tools/analyze/AnalyzeFormFooter.tsx:58 The only configuration in this context is per-run form input (report language, blind screening), mirrored into a sessionStorage draft. That is client state under the subject's own boundary, not a durable settings store. Searching app/features/tools/analyze (including subdirectories) for 'settings', 'getSetting' and 'setSetting' found no hits.
